Commercial Property to let

4 Town Square – A fantastic opportunity to occupy a prominent ground floor retail unit in the heart of Stevenage Town Centre. Excellent footfall, strong neighbouring retailers and a versatile open plan sales area.

Get the latest news to your inbox

Sign up for our digital newsletter. They’re sent out three times a year and include information about your local area, including community events, news, and more.

- opens new window

Need a garage or extra storage?

Whether it's a spot for your car, a commercial garage, or just some extra storage space - we've got just what you need! Bidding is open Friday to Tuesday - don’t miss out - have a browse and secure your perfect space today!

Have your say...

Find information on how to comment on proposed Traffic Regulation Orders (TROs), along with other consultations that may affect your area. You can also share your feedback on our services to help us improve and better meet the needs of our community.

Committee Meetings

Members of the public are welcome to attend our committee meetings. Agendas are published eight days before each meeting is held.
